episodes.title: Welcome to the Boroughs
episodes.summary: When grieving widower Sam Cooper reluctantly moves to a desert retirement community, he discovers something is lurking beneath its perfect surface.

episodes.title: The Mourning After
episodes.summary: Still reeling, Sam seeks answers close to home. Renee gets a break in the case of the missing minerals. Judy and Wally face up to painful realities.

episodes.title: A Pyramid
episodes.summary: Sam and Wally decide to take a risk. Renee and Paz's investigation brings them closer together. Art seeks answers in the desert.

episodes.title: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.summary: Art savors the fruits of his explorations. Blaine warns Sam that curiosity comes with consequences. Renee makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Another Beautiful Day
episodes.summary: Sam, Judy and Wally uncover a new side of The Boroughs. Renee and Paz go on a road trip. Blaine tries to convince Claire to take action.

episodes.title: The Grey Rebellion
episodes.summary: With the entire gang under Blaine's thumb, Sam desperately seeks a way out. Art and Judy hit a breaking point. Wally gets a taste of a new life.

episodes.title: Time to Go
episodes.summary: As the anniversary party approaches, Anneliese reveals a painful secret. The gang gets in gear for a high-stakes rescue mission at The Manor.

episodes.title: Triple Audible
episodes.summary: With Blaine and Anneliese desperate to capture Mother, Sam and his friends put it all on the line to save their neighbors and set things right.
